reviews.title: Good game but…
reviews.text: So this is a really good game but there is a lot of problems people may have not mentioned. First of all, this game is way to easy. I think there should be challenges and you can go against other online players. Second, this game kinda tricks you. Every time I’m playing the game, it glitches. When it shows I can play a game or get a skin, I click yes and it brings me a video which is normal, but every time I look in my shoe thingy, I do not see the skin or shoe. Third, this game is boring. All we do is change shoes and win the game most of the time, because it’s always so easy. So I think yall or you should make some more stuff in the game. This is all I have to report. Thank you.

reviews.title: Paid for no adds still get ads
reviews.text: We paid for no ads, and while “technically” that allows you to not be forced into watching ads, you still watch them. The home page still shows an ad in the side with inappropriate pictures. During the start and end, the big green buttons to click through to start or collect rewards, is all to watch an ad with a  bonuses. There is a small print button at the bottom to click on to continue without the ad.

reviews.title: Fun game but..
reviews.text: The game is pretty decent, but the ads for it aren’t very appropriate. The game can get boring quickly, so I’d say it’s like a mini-game. But in my opinion I suggest you add more to the game, so it can last longer for people. since some people got all the clothes already. About the ads being inappropriate, I did see one add about this game. It had bad language, and was being rude. Please make sure the ads for this game don’t ruin the game itself. Other than that, I enjoy the game, and I do recommend it for people who like mini-games like these. :)
